reason: B provides the more physically specific and evidence-grounded mechanism—LCO-dependent fault-energy fluctuations and nanoscale dislocation detrapping—with a controlled, measurable comparison and explicit falsification test. Neither proposal fully addresses genuinely high-temperature behavior, and B overstates twinning as a general consequence of LCO, but it is substantially stronger than A, which conflates lattice distortion with ordering and lacks supporting evidence.
